issues.description: The PersonResource.createPerson endpoint in the solution returns a raw Person (and returns null on invalid input) while NoteResource.createNote uses ResponseEntity<Note> and returns ResponseEntity.badRequest() for invalid input. The problem statement explicitly suggests using NoteResource as inspiration for PersonResource. This mismatch in return type and error signalling is structural and can confuse students about the expected controller contract and how to handle bad input consistently across resources.
issues.suggestedFix: Make PersonResource.createPerson consistent with NoteResource by returning ResponseEntity<Person> and returning ResponseEntity.badRequest().build() for invalid input (e.g., when person.getId() != null). This aligns the persons endpoints with the notes endpoints and follows the guidance in the problem statement.
